newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bank of Ireland signs transfer agreement.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Ireland signs transfer agreement.

text.p: Bank of Ireland said on Thursday that it had signed a transfer agreement with British building society Bristol and West.

The bank said in a statement that the transfer agreement signed by the relevant parties was in respect of the proposed transfer of the business of Bristol and West Building Society to a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bank of Ireland, to be called Bristol and West Plc.
It said completion of the transaction is conditional on the approval of investing and borrowing members of the society at a special general meeting of the society to be held on April 15, 1997.

Bank of Ireland said the transaction was also conditional on the approval of the ordinary stockholders of Bank of Ireland which would be sought at an extraordinary general court of the bank, to be held on April 23, 1997.

"In the event that the UK Building Societies Commission confirms the transaction and that all other conditions are met within the timeframe currently planned, it is anticipated that the business of the society will be transferred to Bristol and West Plc on July 28, 1997, and the distribution of cash and preference shares will take place on or before August 25, 1997," Bank of Ireland said.
Bank of Ireland said the consideration, which values the society at 600 million pounds sterling, would be satisfied by a combination of cash and preference shares in Bristol and West Plc.
